name: Attacking 4-3-3

slots.why: A high line leaves space behind, so the keeper must claim through balls early; a sweeper keeper would suit this even better.
Attacking wing-back supplies the width so the winger can cut inside.
Central defender who covers the space the attacking full-backs leave. Cover is the alternate.
Ball-playing defender starts attacks from the back and steps out with the high line.
Attacking wing-back on the right, giving the inside forward room to cut in.
Holding central midfielder screens the back four while the other two go forward.
Box-to-box midfielder links defence to attack and supports the press.
Mezzala drifts into the half-space to arrive in the box and act as a fourth attacker.
Winger holds the touchline, stretching the defence for the inside forward and striker.
Inside forward cuts in to shoot and attack the far post.
Advanced Forward runs in behind a high defensive line. Poacher is the alternate for a natural finisher.

description: An aggressive 4-3-3 committing full-backs, midfield runners and wide forwards to attack.
whyGood: It creates several simultaneous attacking lanes and is useful when the team must force the game.
whyThisShape: A 4-3-3 pushed to its attacking limit: attacking full-backs supply the width, the wingers can move inside, and a three-man midfield keeps some cover. Up to five players can be in the final third at once.
whenToUse: Against sides that defend deep and cannot get past your press, or when you are clearly the stronger team and want to pin them back.
whenNotToUse: Against quick counter-attackers when your full-backs are slow to recover: the space behind both full-backs is the weakness.

instructionRationale.Much Higher Line of Engagement: Starts the press near the opposition box, so the ball is won high and the full-backs start advanced.
instructionRationale.Higher Defensive Line: Compresses the pitch so the midfield can support the attackers; it needs pace at the back.
instructionRationale.Shorter Passing: Keeps the ball among the midfielders and wide players rather than giving it away with hopeful passes.
instructionRationale.Higher Tempo: Moves the ball quickly to the front three before the defence sets.
instructionRationale.Counter-Press: Regains the ball immediately, which also protects the space behind the full-backs.
